title: Public Alert No. 16/2025 – Alert on Counterfeit/Falsified Rosprazole (Rabeprazole Injection) 20mg

products.manufacturer: Nil; manufactured for Celeste Farmaceutical Inc., 2063, Rabari Vas Khoraj, Gujarat, India

summary: NAFDAC warns of falsified Rosprazole (Rabeprazole Injection) 20mg bearing fake NAFDAC Reg. No. C4-0150, which actually belongs to an Amlodipine tablet. Batch PLED23108. It may lack active ingredient or contain contaminants, risking organ failure or death.
